title: jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis
why_read: A screen-reading assistant tool for auto-suggesting chat replies in Chinese social apps, interesting mainly as a UI automation approach rather than for broad technical novelty.
analysis: This tool reads on-screen chat content in apps like QQ and X without hooking into or modifying the app itself, and suggests candidate replies that the user can insert with one click. The 'non-invasive, read-only' design is a reasonable privacy-conscious approach to building assistant tools on closed platforms. Technically it's a fairly standard screen-scraping-plus-LLM-suggestion pattern, so the main interest is in seeing this applied to a real popular use case, dating or chat-response assistance, at reasonable scale given its star count.
